title: HtmlBdo
responsibility: Renders the native bdo element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlBdo.attributes
inputs.description: Native bdo attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlBdo.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native bdo element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlBdo
outputs.description: The actual native bdo element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
